## [Defective Table](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/679aa90e193b8f2499329458)
Table defective. Bought a pedestal dining room table with walnut veneer. At about 40 days the clear coat of the veneer failed. We were keeping score while playing a board game. The imprint of the names & numbers cut through the clear coat. Nothing excessive Nothing in item description suggests it would be fragile for everyday use.

Our designer reached out to them with a description of the issue and images. No attempt to satisfy customer with return or exchange. Not sure how they justify this.

01.30.25 Update: Vendor response is not acceptable. This $3000.00 table (w/tax and freight) is listed as appropriate for dining and entertaining. A coaster would not have assisted this circumstance and the description of merchandise is misleading at best. Considering the failure to offer any remedy, let the buyer beware when working with this company. Where there's smoke...

January 11, 2025

Unprompted review

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jan 30, 2025

We thank you for reaching out. The table was delivered in new condition, and we regret to hear about the concerns regarding its finish. Based on the images provided, the scratches appear to have resulted from pressure applied through paper or a similar material without protective layering underneath.

To help prevent future damage, we recommend following the care instructions below:

Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.

Use coasters to protect the surface from moisture and scratches.

Avoid harsh chemicals, as they may damage the finish.

Consider using protective coverings to preserve the wood’s integrity.

A local furniture technician may be able to repair and reseal the surface for added durability.

We understand the disappointment and appreciate the feedback.
